entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To track an existing order, press one. To speak with a representative, please stay on the line.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's just not what I expected and I'm pretty frustrated with the whole thing.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into starting a return for you. Could I get your order number, please?
Yeah, hold on. It's VF-556-321.
Got it, VF-556-321. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, and it looks like it was delivered to you 13 days ago. Is that correct?
Thirteen days, sure. Whatever. Can we just get this return started? I'm on my lunch break.
Of course. It's just that I'm seeing an issue here on my end. The VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return policy, and since we're on day 13, the system won't let me process it.
Wait, what? Ten days? That's insane. Your policy says 90 days! I'm looking at it right now. I expect a full refund.

I understand your frustration, sir, and I do apologize for the confusion. While most of our items have a 90-day window, specific electronics like the Pulse are an exception. Unfortunately, since it's past the cutoff, my hands are tied.
Your hands are tied? So I'm just out the money? This is completely unacceptable. I want to speak to your supervisor right now.
I understand. Okay, look... don't hang up. I'm really not supposed to do this, and my **manager would kill me** if she found out. But you're only a few days over, and I can see this is frustrating.
So what are you going to do?
I'm going to try to **override the system**. As a **one-time exception**, I can manually approve the return. Please give me just one moment to see if it works.
Fine. Just make it quick.
Okay... and... success! I was able to push it through for you. I've just initiated the return, and a pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email address right now.
Oh. Wow, really? You actually did it?
Yes, sir. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay, well... thank you. Seriously. I appreciate you bending the rules for me. I was ready for a fight.
It's no problem at all. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks again, Sam.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great afternoon.
